voidgrubs.notes: 3 Voidgrubs, spawn once per game (no respawn). Despawn at 14:45 (14:55 if in combat). Each grub gives your team a Touch of the Void stack (structure burn); 3 stacks add Hunger of the Void (allied Voidmites on turrets) - strong for side-lane pushing.

byLane.top: 3 Voidgrubs, spawn once per game (no respawn). Despawn at 14:45 (14:55 if in combat). Each grub gives your team a Touch of the Void stack (structure burn); 3 stacks add Hunger of the Void (allied Voidmites on turrets) - very strong for a splitpusher like you.
byLane.mid: 3 Voidgrubs, spawn once per game (no respawn). Despawn at 14:45 (14:55 if in combat). The pit is top side of the river: push mid first and help your jungler there. Grubs give structure burn (Touch of the Void) that helps take the mid turret.

riftHerald.notes: Spawns once in the grub pit, despawns 19:45 (19:55 in combat). Eye of the Herald summons a pushing Herald - use it in a lane where your team can follow up to take plates and the turret.

byLane.top: Spawns once in the grub pit, despawns 19:45 (19:55 in combat). Eye of the Herald summons a pushing Herald - use it top to take plates/turret when your jungler can help.
byLane.mid: Spawns once in the grub pit, despawns 19:45 (19:55 in combat). Eye of the Herald summons a pushing Herald - mid is the best lane for it: the mid turret falls fast and opens the map.

elderDragon.spawn: After a team secures Dragon Soul (4th drake)

objectiveTimers.otherNotes: Atakhan no longer exists (removed 26.1). Minions spawn 0:30, jungle camps 0:55. Hand of Baron lasts 180 s. Top: your top quest finishes around 13:35 at the latest - plan Teleport plays around Herald (15:00) and drakes. Mid: you are closest to both river objectives - push first and move first to dragon and grubs.

seasonFacts: Atakhan was removed in 26.1; Baron spawns at 20:00 again (6:00 respawn).
Voidgrubs: one camp of 3 at 8:00, despawns 14:45. Rift Herald: once at 15:00, despawns 19:45. Dragon: 5:00, respawns 5:00 after kill; Elder 6:00 after the 4th drake.
Minions spawn at 0:30 (was 1:05). Feats of Strength removed: First Blood +100g, first turret +300g.
Turret plates are permanent (no 14:00 fall-off) and exist on inner and inhibitor turrets too. Melee champions deal 20% more damage to turrets.
Crystalline Overgrowth builds on a turret not hit for ~90s; the next champion attack consumes it for bonus true damage to the turret.

Top role quest (1200 pts): +2/minion and +40/plate in top lane, +50 turret, +15 takedown, +30 epic monster, plus passive gain; recalling pauses passive gain 12s; progress outside your lane is penalized early. Jax average completion ~12:30. Rewards: bonus XP, +11% XP gain, +80 XP per takedown, level cap 20, and a free Teleport (390s cd as of 26.19) or, if you took Teleport, an upgraded TP with a max-HP shield.
Jax gets +1.5% attack speed per passive stack at level 19 (26.1). Leap Strike costs 50 mana; Counter Strike deals 4-8% target max HP (26.12).
damageProfilesNotes: Share of each champion's damage that is magic (0 = all physical, 1 = all magic) with the usual build. A list [full AD build, full AP build, usual build] marks champions whose items decide it: once they own damage items, the app moves them inside that range. Champions not listed are estimated from their class. True damage counts as neither.
rulesNotes: Rules every playbook gets, placed before the rule named in 'before'. A playbook overrides one by having a rule with the same id. They have no voice: the app announces Dragon Soul point and Elder separately, with an alert tone.

rules.reason: {bigDragon.point == 'theirs' ? 'If they take it they have Dragon Soul for the rest of the game. ' : bigDragon.point == 'ours' ? 'This dragon gives your team Dragon Soul. ' : 'Whoever takes it gets Dragon Soul. '}{bigDragon.status == 'up' ? 'Be at the pit with your team, or make them pay with a tower or Baron on the other side' : 'Push your wave now, reset if you need to, and move down with your team before it spawns'}

rules.headline: {bigDragon.status == 'up' ? 'Elder Dragon is up' : 'Elder Dragon in ' + clock(bigDragon.in)}
rules.reason: {bigDragon.status == 'up' ? 'Elder executes low-health enemies: fight for it together, never alone' : 'Push your wave and group before it spawns'}

rules.note: v2 safety: the tower doesn't protect you (matchup threat or a big lead after 6) and you're low or their jungler is close
rules.headline: Not safe in lane: recall
rules.reason: {threat && threat.why ? threat.why : oppName + ' can dive you at your tower'}{me.hp < 0.45 ? ', and you have ' + pct(me.hp) + ' health' : ''}{jg && jg.status == 'near' ? ', ' + jg.name + ' is close' : ''}
do: Recall now; the tower takes the wave for you
Come back after the next wave crashes (or with Teleport if you have it)
rules.voice: Not safe at your tower now. Recall.

rules.note: v2 safety: the tower won't save you, so 'stay under tower' isn't enough
rules.headline: {threat && threat.headline ? threat.headline : 'Your tower will not protect you: stay behind it'}
rules.reason: {threat && threat.why ? threat.why : oppName + ' is strong enough to dive you'}
do: {threat && threat.do ? threat.do : 'Stand behind your tower, never at its edge'}
Take only cannons and minions right next to the tower
dont: Walking up for a minion while {oppName} stands next to the wave
rules.voice: {threat && threat.voice ? threat.voice : 'Your tower is not safe now. Stay behind it.'}

dragon_soul_point: Push your side wave and reset before the spawn so you arrive with full HP and items.
If your team can't contest, trade it: take a tower, Herald or Baron on the other side at the same moment.
elder_dragon: Elder decides games: arrive together, never face-check the river alone.
Whoever gets Elder should force a fight right away while the execute lasts.

hints.text: {oppName} runs Ghost: don't count on outrunning him
Your outer turret is gone: the lane is longer, so ganks reach you more easily
{oppName} killed you {deathsGame.soloToOpp} times alone: fight only when it says All-in
